body:
I can reproduce this even with TERM=vte . Will try to look into it.
I've written some tests to check that correct OSC/CSI are sebt but still have to make a PR for it.

I am seeing this issue as well after updating nvim on homebrew.

```

   system vimrc file: "$VIM/sysinit.vim"

```
So this is a regression? Did it work before #6816 ? cc @jdebp

Just FYI, I can not reproduce this in urxvt, xfce4-terminal or alacritty with current master. So I don't know what is going wrong here...

EDIT: Perhaps the problem is a third party lib? As I'm using gentoo, I don't use most of the bundled libs.

@wsdjeg Did `set guicursor=a:ver25-blinkon1` work in an older version of Nvim? What libvte (**not** libvterm) version is termite using? And what version of termite (as requested by the issue template)?

in old neovim, before 6816,  `set guicursor=a:ver25-blinkon10` will change my cursor to a blink `|`. so I think it works well in old nvim.

my termite version is `termite v12`, I do not know how to check version of `libvte`. but I can see
```
✔ wsdjeg:neovim [ master | ✔  ] ➭ pacman -Ss vte | grep installed
extra/vte 0.28.2-8 [installed]
extra/vte-common 0.48.3-1 [installed]
community/libvterm 0.1.git1.c4317a6-2 [installed]
community/termite 12-2 [installed]
community/termite-terminfo 12-2 [installed]
community/vte3-ng 0.48.3.a-1 [installed]
```

Termite uses a fork of libvte to add some features:
https://github.com/thestinger/termite/tree/v12#dependencies

If you are using a recent version of that fork, then it seems like the version should be 0.48.2

I upgraded to vte 0.48.3 and tried again with xfce4-terminal. I still do not see a horizontal bar instead of a vertical bar. So I don't think this is a problem with vte itself.

@wsdjeg Does it change anything if you change `TERM` to `xterm-256color` ? This is what xfce4-terminal is set to by default.

> So this is a regression? Did it work before #6816 ? cc @jdebp

This worked in NVIM v0.2.1-442-g69f0847cc and does not work in NVIM v0.2.1-516-g226603a8d

I'm in iTerm2 on macOS Sierra in tmux master with `TERM=screen-256color` with `guicursor=`:

```
    let &guicursor = 'n-v-c-sm:block-blinkwait1000-blinkon500-blinkoff500,'
        \          . 'i-c-ci-ve:ver25-blinkwait1000-blinkon500-blinkoff500,'
        \          . 'r-cr-o:hor20-blinkwait1000-blinkon500-blinkoff500'
```

@wsdjeg I not sure, but I think that it might then be that the termite terminfo is not correct. If I understand the recent changes correctly, then neovim now trusts/uses the terminfo more than before. So if the terminfo is not correct then there will be problems.
Another data point: I can still get a vertical bar both inside and outside of tmux with `TERM=xterm-256color`. I assume it causes other issues inside tmux though.

If you are using tmux  TERM is only two choices:

screen-256color
tmux-256color

Pick one.

?

`screen-256color` is what I've picked already. I'm just saying this particular problem goes away when I temporarily change to `xterm-256color` for testing.
